hints.title: Information Schema Introspection
hints.text: Query information_schema.columns to inspect the table schema and discover all store columns other than product_id.

hints.title: UNION ALL Query Formulation
hints.text: Construct dynamic queries extracting product_id, store name, and price for each store column where price is not null.

hints.title: Concatenate and Execute
hints.text: Combine the queries using union set operations and run them via dynamic statement preparation.
